title: Tracking Bleach Synchronized Worms
author: Priota Islam
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yb4fsqw

steps.title: Prepare Imaging Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare and pour low peptone NGM onto 35mm imaging plates and seed them with OP50.

substeps.instruction: Store plates in the cold room for at least 2 days before use.
Seed imaging plates with 50ul of freshly made 1:10 solution (OP50:M9 solution) the day before recording.
Leave plates on the bench to dry overnight with the lid on.

steps.title: Synchronize Worm Population
steps.instruction: Synchronize the worm strains using bleach synchronization and starvation.

substeps.instruction: Chunk the worms on 3 maintenance plates.
Bleach the worms after 2 days following the protocol for Bleach synchronization of c elegans.
Refeed the starved L1s on 2 different OP50 seeded NGM plates 72 hours prior to the experiment day.

steps.title: Prepare and Record Worms
steps.instruction: Transfer synchronized adults to imaging plates and record their movement.

substeps.instruction: Using a hair pick, pick 5 young adults onto the seeded imaging plates.
Place plates on the tracker agar side up with the lids off.
Wait 30 minutes for the worms to acclimatize.
Record for 15 minutes (refer to 'Imaging on the multiworm tracker' protocol for detailed instructions).
